title: Jet Bundles as Higher-Order Polarised $k$-Contact Manifolds
summary: We prove that the Cartan distribution $C^r_π$ on the jet bundle $J^rπ$, for $π:E\rightarrow Q$, is an $N^r_π$-contact distribution, where $N^r_π$ is the corank of $C^r_π$. In other words, $C^r_π$ has non-degenerate distributional curvature, and admits, locally, a complementary distribution spanned by $N^r_π$ commuting infinitesimal symmetries. Consequently, there exists around every point of $J^rπ$ an open $U\subset J^rπ$ and an $R^{N^r_π}$-valued one-form $η\inΩ^1(U,R^{N^r_π})$ such that $\kerη= C^r_π|_U$ and $\kerη\oplus\ker dη=TU$. This recovers the canonical structure of $J^rπ$,…
